# Symaira

> Symaira is a local-first, open-source product family for human–AI collaboration. Products run on the user's machine, do not require a cloud service, and expose a Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface where applicable. Developed in Germany by Daniel Justus with a GDPR-first approach.

## Current source and distribution state

Browse, Operate and Scope completed their source/consumer cutover to optional Symaira Brain modules on 2026-09-13. The former `symaira-browse` repository is archived. Symaira Cockpit is the hardware/system-tuning product; its Operate and Scope source routes are retired. No signed Brain-module release or package-manager migration has been published yet.

Install current released products on macOS/Linux via Homebrew: `brew tap danieljustus/tap`, then `brew install symvault symbrain symdesk symcockpit symeraseme symfritz` and `brew install --cask symdesk-app`. The historical `symbrowse` formula is deprecated; use the Brain-managed source build for the cutover path.

## Security & Privacy Tools

- [Symaira Vault (symvault)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-vault): Terminal-native, age-encrypted password and secrets manager for developers and AI agents. Scoped MCP tokens, `symvault run` environment injection, TOTP, autotype, Git sync and a native macOS client.
- [Symaira EraseMe (symeraseme)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-eraseme): Plans, sends, tracks and verifies data-broker erasure campaigns with human approval and evidence.

## Context & Knowledge Tools

- [Symaira Brain (symbrain)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-brain): Portable agent context/control layer. One MCP gateway exposes memory/entities, skills and scoped credential access, with profile-specific policy. Its optional Browse, Operate and Scope modules are independently selectable and managed from Brain sources.
- [Browse module](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-brain/tree/main/browse): Brain-owned browser worker with Chrome CDP and static fetching, reusable flows, stable element references and human handoff for 2FA/CAPTCHA/approvals. It remains a direct CLI/MCP/daemon worker and does not require Brain memory at runtime.
- [Symaira Desktop (symdesk)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-desktop): Local-first Markdown workspace with hybrid retrieval, OCR/document ingestion, PDF output, meeting capture, contact references and a signed project journal. It can compose Brain-managed tools at runtime and degrades gracefully when they are absent.

## System tools (macOS focus)

- [Symaira Cockpit (symcockpit)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-cockpit): Native macOS hardware/system tuning for thermals, power, displays, focus and cooling; structured CLI, MCP and tuning history.
- [Symaira Fritz (symfritz)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-fritz): CLI and MCP server for AVM FRITZ!Box routers: network topology, host diagnosis, guest WLAN, Wake-on-LAN and DECT smart-home switching.
